_instructions: 2. Merge the 'punji-metadata' block into the existing 'mcpServers' object.
Do NOT replace the whole file — only add this entry.
3. Replace /absolute/path/to/server.py with the actual path to server.py on your machine.
4. Replace YOUR_YOUTUBE_API_KEY_HERE with your real YouTube Data API v3 key.
5. Replace python3 with the full path to your Python 3.10+ interpreter if needed.
e.g. on macOS with system Python: /usr/bin/python3
6. Fully quit Claude Desktop (Cmd+Q) and reopen it.
7. On first use, call authenticate_youtube in the chat to complete OAuth setup.
